responsibility: Contains late peephole2 optimizations for T-Head vendor extensions, focused on XTheadMemPair. It recognizes adjacent scalar load/store sequences, including sign- and zero-extending 32-to-64-bit load pairs, checks pairability through helper predicates, and rewrites them into parallel forms that the T-Head mempair instruction patterns can later emit, making it a narrow post-selection combiner for T-Head memory-pair instructions.
